_what: How much model work Trillion lets run, owned by src/model-calls.mjs. Trillion never pays for a chat model: a conversation goes to the AI the person chose (order_your_ais) on their own account, and is refused, telling them once a day, when they chose none. `paid_inputs` say which work that is, by the shape of what is sent (a row names the input field such work always carries): any other call that is not a conversation (an image to draw, a prompt to complete) is refused with NotPaidByTrillion before anything is sent, whoever asks (a store, the shared pool, a hosted Site, a Marketplace model tool). The rows below bound that work, run on Trillion's AI binding; `binding_callers` are the only files that may call that binding (scripts/check-reaches.mjs, row ai-binding of scripts/reaches.json, refuses a change that adds another). Every model call is counted by day, purpose (what it is for, named by its caller) and model. A budget row is { id, label, scope, when, measure, most, alert_at, per, stop }: scope says whose calls it counts (person: one person's own store; account: every person's together, summed in the shared pool), when is a formula-engine rule tree over the call's facts (purpose, model; null covers every call), measure is one of measures, most is the daily threshold; stop false only alerts, otherwise such calls are refused, alert_at is the share of most at which the person is told it is getting close, and per: "purpose" counts and stops each purpose on its own (left out, the row counts every call it covers together). A paid_inputs row with remember keeps each item's answer by its identity (memory names where, answers_in the reply field holding one answer per item), so the same item is never paid for twice. A refused call is never dropped silently: its caller says so (the check judge marks the check unjudged). Adding a budget, a purpose or a model is a row here; nothing in code names one. Model price rows map token use or audio minutes to neurons. Billable priced models must have a verified price row; unpriced models remain visible in token reports and cannot be included in dollar admission.

paid_inputs.why: Turning words into numbers for search and closeness: no chat AI a person chose does this.

remember.why: The same words embedded by the same model give the same numbers: each text is kept by its identity and never paid for twice (src/model-calls.mjs invariant 6). On 2026-10-10 one person made 19,955 embedding calls of about 11 tokens each, most of them the same job and goal texts again.

paid_inputs.why: Hearing a recording or a live microphone: no chat AI a person chose does this.

budgets.label: Searches and transcriptions Trillion runs for one person
budgets._why: Counted per purpose: only the kind of work that ran away stops for the day, every other search and transcription keeps going. On 2026-10-10 the whole-person count reached 20,000 at 08:10Z on repeated embeddings and stopped every search by meaning in the account.

notice.body: {used} of {most} {measure} on {day}. This is an operator alert; customer work continues. Customer-chosen caps remain independent.

budgets.label: Searches and transcriptions Trillion runs for everyone
budgets._why: This shared threshold counts and alerts operators about all Trillion-paid calls. It does not stop customers, including after restart or through reservation admission. Per-person stopping budgets remain independent.
